name: Thomas A. Plein Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: A $4,500 scholarship for a domestic UQ undergraduate in financial hardship.
key: $4,500, depending on the fund's distribution that year. One award.
who: Domestic UQ students enrolled full-time in an undergraduate program.
Able to show financial hardship with documents.
need: Evidence of hardship, such as Centrelink statements, ATO statements or family income.
how: Apply with the Apply now form on the scholarship page.
catches: The amount can be more or less in some years.
